name: GBIF Data
description: Fetch georeferenced GBIF occurrence records by map view, layer extent, country or worldwide, with taxon search, major groups, record type, year, photo, IUCN, uncertainty and licence filters, a live counter, density tiles, a record popup and citation tools for a derived-dataset DOI. Independent plugin, not affiliated with GBIF.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah

screenshots.caption: 1,500 bird (Aves) records around Bandung, West Java, as a point layer with the GBIF Data panel and results card
Threatened species (IUCN CR, EN, VU) across Java; the popup of a Critically Endangered record with photo credit and licence
GBIF hexagon density tiles of every matching bird record, under the fetched points
Record popup with photo, and the Cite this data card: licence mix, citation text and dataset list for a DOI
